parsedVerdict.reasoning: CancelBookingService fits the application-layer role. It is a use-case service that implements the inbound port CancelBooking. Its constructor takes only ports the project declares itself (BookingRepository, GuestRepository, PaymentGateway and NotificationSender). It coordinates loading the booking, calling the domain behaviour, refunding the payment, saving the booking and notifying the guest, and it returns a view model (BookingView) that the project declares. No signature uses a type from a framework, web or transport package. The class has no decorators or framework base classes. The file contains no HTTP request, response or status code, and it does no persistence or I/O except through the ports. The business rule for cancelling stays in the domain object, because the service just calls booking.cancel(). The service raises a domain BookingError, not an HTTP error. No candidate flags were raised.
